"ENC_ID","UNIT","MRN","PAT_NAME","NOTE_TYPE","NOTE_DT","AUTHOR","NOTE_TEXT" "HAR-77104492","4 WEST ONC","408213","Early, Constance","CONSULT NOTE - ADDICTION MED","05/01/2071 10:05","ATAKAHASHI","CONSULT NOTE. Requested by Dr. Paine for OD eval.

Pt says she was takin more than usual for back pain after 'a bad week', denies wanting to die. Last use ~ 1h before found. Not sure if the Rx or street. Prior contact w/ this service 10/2069 - 01/2070, monthly visits, then lost to f/u during pregnancy. Pt states she 'did good' until the baby came.
Meds: B12 inj (listed active), medroxyprogesterone stopped 05/2069 per chart. No other. Allergies NKDA. Attending named on the order is wrong (Dr. Voss is onc, not following).
Exam: drowsy but oriented, pupils 3mm reactive, no tracks, RR 14. Affect flat, tearful when baby discussed. GAD-7 not repeated.
A/P: 1. Opioid use disorder, OD yesterday - offer MOUD, pt interested in bup, will start when COWS > 8. Naloxone kit at d/c + teach husband Toby. 2. Postpartum mood - screen EPDS before d/c, SW consult. 3. Chronic pain - nonopioid plan, PCP f/u Dr. Aldous, Cobbler Hill. 4. Contraception disc. at f/u, pt unsure. Will resee tmrw.
